[!buildmode:plugin] skip
[short] skip
[!cgo] skip '-buildmode=plugin requires external linking'
[!GOOS:linux] skip

env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd i/main
! logos build -buildmode=plugin -o $WORK/bin/i.so ./plug
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/idep'' reaches ''syscall\.Exec'''
cd ../..

cd x/main
! logos build -buildmode=plugin -o $WORK/bin/x.so ./plug
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/xdep'' reaches ''syscall\.Exec'''
stderr 'example\.com/xdep\.Run\(\) +at [^ ]+\.go:\d+'
! stderr 'unauthorized_(cgo|net|reflect)'

cp allow-logos.toml logos.toml
logos build -buildmode=plugin -o $WORK/bin/x.so ./plug
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cd ../..

cd c/main
logos build -buildmode=plugin -o $WORK/bin/c.so ./plug
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cd ../..

-- i/main/go.mod --
module example.com/imain

go 1.27

require example.com/idep v0.0.0

replace example.com/idep => ../dep

-- i/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_reflect = "allow"
transitive_net = "allow"

-- i/main/plug/plug.go --
package main

import _ "example.com/idep"

func main() {}

-- i/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/idep

go 1.27

-- i/dep/dep.go --
package idep

import "syscall"

func init() {
	syscall.Exec("/bin/true", nil, nil)
}

-- x/main/go.mod --
module example.com/xmain

go 1.27

require example.com/xdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/xdep => ../dep

-- x/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_reflect = "allow"
transitive_net = "allow"

-- x/main/allow-logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "allow"
transitive_reflect = "allow"
transitive_net = "allow"

-- x/main/plug/plug.go --
package main

import "example.com/xdep"

func Run() {
	xdep.Run()
}

func main() {}

-- x/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/xdep

go 1.27

-- x/dep/dep.go --
package xdep

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Run() {
	syscall.Exec("/bin/true", nil, nil)
}

-- c/main/go.mod --
module example.com/cmain

go 1.27

require example.com/cdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/cdep => ../dep

-- c/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_reflect = "allow"
transitive_net = "allow"

-- c/main/plug/plug.go --
package main

import "example.com/cdep"

func Pid() int {
	return cdep.Pid()
}

func main() {}

-- c/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/cdep

go 1.27

-- c/dep/dep.go --
package cdep

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Pid() int {
	return syscall.Getpid()
}
